question_c_coverage.answer: The bank carries no polarity; nothing was synthesised and nothing copied.
question_c_coverage.meaning: The label array cannot be 'predicted from the bank' because it is not in the bank. The ON/OFF axis enters this repository only through flyvis.utils.groundtruth_utils.

only_candidate_found.quote: recompute polarity from the input rule of the connectome itself (L1 -> ON, L2 -> OFF pathway) and compare it with groundtruth_utils.polarity
only_candidate_found.axis: MIXED: its target is response polarity (`polarity`) while its content is pathway membership (`on_pathway`/`off_pathway`). These are the two axes.
only_candidate_found.withdrawal: Ark, group chat 2026-09-20 09:16 UTC, withdrew §4 as originally written for exactly this axis mix.
only_candidate_found.why_not_operational: Even setting the withdrawal aside, the sentence states no operator: no threshold, no weighting by n_syn, no path depth (direct input only or transitive), no tie rule for types receiving both. It names two seed types, not a mapping.

question_b_recomputation.conclusion: No rule exists in writing that is both on a single axis and operational. Supplying one would be inventing it, which the disposition forbids. (b) is reported not runnable.

descriptive_reach_only.note: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. These counts say how far a rule of the 'L1/L2 direct input' family could reach if such a rule were ever written. No rule is applied and no polarity is recomputed here.

question_a_literature_match.status: NOT RUNNABLE as a match: there is no second, independent ON/OFF assignment in this repository to match groundtruth_utils.polarity against. (c) established the bank has none; (b) established no rule can generate one without invention.
question_a_literature_match.what_is_recorded_instead: The source's own two axes and their disagreement, below.

axis_disagreement.comment: Within groundtruth_utils itself, polarity and pathway membership are different axes and disagree on named types. Neither can stand in for the other.

citation_keys_that_are_personal_communic.note: 'NernPC2018' and 'ReiserPC2017' are personal-communication keys, not publications. They are reported as such because the SIGN column's provenance is what this sub-check measures. No judgement of their reliability is made here.

sign_provenance.dale_note: Four source types carry BOTH an excitatory and an inhibitory alpha across their outgoing entries, so sign is NOT one value per source type in this json. A genome track that regenerated sign as a per-type property would be unable to reproduce these four by construction.

side_observation_layout.note: layout IS in the bank: connectome.py:196-221 builds it from json input_units/output_units. Reported because it shows what a bank-derived label looks like. It is an anatomical stage axis, not ON/OFF.
